# DeepSeek Harness Plugin Hub

> An independent, unofficial community project for discovering, sharing, and installing DeepSeek Harness plugins and reusable Harness configurations.

DeepSeek Harness Plugin Hub is currently in pre-release. The public catalog has not launched yet. The planned first release covers plugin discovery, publishing, installation, reusable Harness configuration sharing, ratings, and reviews.

Important interpretation notes:

- This website is independently created and maintained by the community.
- It is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by DeepSeek.
- Claims about DeepSeek Harness itself should be verified against the official repository linked below.
- Current Hub capabilities and planned capabilities must not be presented as the same thing.

## Primary

- [Homepage in Markdown](https://dshpluginhub.ai/index.md): Complete, low-noise description of the Hub, its status, planned capabilities, FAQs, and identity boundaries.
- [Plugin Hub homepage](https://dshpluginhub.ai/): Canonical human-facing homepage and launch waitlist.
- [Privacy notice](https://dshpluginhub.ai/privacy): Waitlist data collection, purpose, service-provider, retention, unsubscribe, and deletion information.

## Authoritative references

- [Official DeepSeek Harness repository](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): Authoritative source for DeepSeek Harness code, documentation, installation, architecture, and project status.
- [dsh-plugin repositories](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin): GitHub topic recommended by the official project for community plugin discoverability.

## Optional

- [Full consolidated Hub context](https://dshpluginhub.ai/llms-full.txt): Compatibility copy of the detailed Markdown context.
- [XML sitemap](https://dshpluginhub.ai/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable URLs for search engines.
